name: FlexBox
description: Flexbox layout primitive for stacks and rows.

a11y.reviewedNote: 2026-05-28 — Breadth beta port: keyboard/ARIA contract reviewed, ForcedColors story added, Storybook axe gate (parameters.a11y.test: error). 2026-07-05 (beta→stable) — re-verified independently: axe-clean across all 7 stories in all four modes; AT snapshots bootstrapped (the component had none — snapshot-backfill debt) and compare-clean in plain/light/dark/forced-colors; Controls 9/9 operable + 0 inert. Pure css-less flex passthrough with no color surface (tokens.colors empty), so light/dark is a structural no-op. Fixed a contract defect: variants.align.default was "center" but the component default is "stretch" (align-items initial). 2026-07-10 — Figma component built (Atoms, node 1176-1698, parity-audit batch B2a): contract axes as variants with DT variable bindings.

gap.description: Shorthand gap (CSS length or number of px).

style.description: Inline style overrides applied after generated flex declarations.

children.description: Flex items rendered inside the container.

forbiddenUse: Rebuild Grid with wrap and width math — two-dimensional layouts belong to Grid.
Hardcode magic px strings when a space token exists; the rhythm gate will flag it.
dense: Style-prop flexbox (css-less by design): direction/wrap/justify/align/alignContent + gap|rowGap|columnGap (number=px, string=token); passes through div attributes

usage.description: FlexBox is the free-form single-axis primitive: every flexbox knob exposed as a prop, emitted as inline style — deliberately css-less. Numbers become px gaps; strings pass through, so prefer space tokens ("var(--space-internal-16)"). Use it for one-off arrangements where Stack's token scale is too coarse; when you just need vertical rhythm, Stack is the sharper tool.

bestPractices.description: Prefer Stack for standard token-gapped rows/columns; FlexBox is for the layouts Stack cannot express.
Pass string gaps as space tokens; numeric gaps are raw px and should stay rare.
Use align="center" for mixed-height inline clusters (icon + text + badge).
Lean on the div passthrough for aria roles when the flex row is semantically a group.
Do not rebuild Grid with wrap and width math — two-dimensional layouts belong to Grid.
Do not hardcode magic px strings when a space token exists; the rhythm gate will flag it.
